description:
## What to change

The comment style asked for on PR #122 -- gently pedagogic, simple, just the facts, with no ticket numbers or ticket state and no capitals used for emphasis -- was applied to `json.fz` only, because that is the file the review pointed at. The sibling modules still carry the old style.

Ticket references appear 17 times, in `enum.fz`, `kernel.fz`, `map.fz`, `range.fz`, `string.fz` and `string_chars.fz`:

```
# fz-5xp.8 -- the default sort is Erlang's TOTAL TERM ORDER, not `<=`.
# `get` is a binary search (fz-5xp.12), which needs the array's order to agree
# with its key equality (fz-5xp.48) ...
```

Capitals-for-emphasis appears on about 39 lines, including whole-phrase shouting (`A map here is a FLAT SORTED ARRAY`, `ITERATION ORDER is by key`, `---- BULK: one pass ----`).

Some of these comments also narrate how the code came to be rather than what it does -- "the tranches fz-5xp.8 (term order), fz-5xp.12 (Map) and fz-5xp.15 (String.Chars) unblocked" is epic state, not a fact about the module.

## How

Keep every fact, including measurements and genuine limitations; drop the provenance around them. Where a comment explains a choice by pointing at a ticket, write the reason instead -- if it cannot be written without the ticket, it is not yet explained. Where a module follows Elixir's model, one note in the `@moduledoc` carries it and the per-clause re-justifications come out.

## Note

`Json.fz` and `Map.fz` line numbers are pinned by `json_roundtrip.expected.diagnostics` and `json_decode_cost.expected.diagnostics`, which quote runtime-library source. Any comment edit in those two modules shifts them, so the goldens are re-blessed with the change. Only line numbers move; compare with the numbers stripped to confirm that.

comments.text: Done in 4e6f9dfcd. Seven modules cleaned (enum, kernel, map, keyword, range, string, string_chars) plus atom and float. 15 ticket refs and ~40 capitals-for-emphasis removed; three comments that disagreed with the code corrected. Six diagnostics goldens re-blessed for line drift (digits-stripped diff identical). Gate green: lib 1971/0, matrix 639/0, aot 30/0, cli 225/0, doc, clippy, fmt.

title: The runtime library's sibling modules still carry ticket numbers and shouty emphasis in their comments
